properties.name: The web of rules is built: a kept computation names its inputs, a changed quantity marks it owed, and a change returns its redo list
properties.rationale: This builds the two requirements @ajs accepted on 2026-10-24 under dec:idea-reflow2-becomes-the-web-of-rules-for-a-buildings-ifc-model, options (b) and (c). Neither had a capability. The root cause (fact:root-cause-a-changed-requirement-does-not-flow-because-the-accepted-web-of-rules-was-never-built-2026-10-25) named it: the Shop sample's household went from four to five and nothing read owed. Shape: a design quantity is a Constraint holding a limit, so no new type is needed (the setpoint direction already means "a value it is held at"). The registrant passes the record's inputs, and the edge keeps what was used. Owed is a comparison between what was used and what the design holds now. reflow2 never reads the file, per the 2026-10-13 dividing line. Inputs are an argument on add_artifact rather than a new tool, which serves job 4. Grouping by trade, and naming dependencies an agent drew unchecked, are left for @ajs to shape. flo2's door must pass `inputs`; see the PR. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Branch feat/web-of-rules (f95aa157b). New code is in crates/reflow2-core/src/owed.rs. add_artifact takes `inputs`, one DEPENDS_ON (data_flow) per input, keeping value_used and unit_used or checksum_used, plus used_basis. loop_status adds computations_owed, owed_computations and resting_on_stale_numbers, counted in `clean`. propagate_from adds redo_list, grouped by kind. derived_report declares computation_owed and redo_list. The schema adds five DEPENDS_ON properties. There is no new tool and no new node or edge type; the tool count stays 199. The fixture: household 4 → 5 makes the food calc owed at distance 1 and the electricity calc at distance 2, and puts two decisions and one limit on stale numbers.
